Services

Weed Control

Sustained, season-long weed suppression in beds, hardscape joints, and lawns — without the dependence on heavy chemicals.

Get a Free Quote

Weed control isn’t a single product. It’s a maintenance rhythm. We combine mechanical removal, well-timed pre-emergents, and mulch depth to keep your beds clean without the constant spray-cycle you see from larger crews. If you want a fully organic program, just ask — we have an organic-only option that works in San Diego’s climate.

What's included

  • Hand-pulling of established weeds
  • Pre-emergent application (timed to seasonal weed germination)
  • Mulch refresh to suppress new growth
  • Targeted spot treatment where needed
  • Optional organic-only program

Common questions

What people ask about weed control.

Do you use Roundup / glyphosate? +

Only as a last resort and only on hardscape joints, with the client's explicit approval. Default is mechanical removal plus mulch and pre-emergents.

Why do the same weeds keep coming back? +

Most weed problems aren't a weed problem — they're a thin-mulch or bare-soil problem. A 2–3 inch mulch refresh once a year resolves 80% of recurring weed issues in beds.
